title: Lipschitz image covered by C¹ images up to an Hⁿ-null set (Simon 3.1.2, first half)
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, K ∈ ℝ≥0 and F : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+ℓ} be K-Lipschitz. Then there are N₀ ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} with Hⁿ(N₀) = 0 (Hⁿ = μHE[n]) and maps G_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+ℓ} (k ∈ ℕ), each of class C¹, such that F(ℝⁿ) ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃_k G_k(ℝⁿ).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (F : Rn n → Amb n ℓ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K F → ∃ (N₀ : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (G : ℕ → Rn n → Amb n ℓ), (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) N₀ = 0 ∧ (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (G k)) ∧ range F ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃ k, range (G k)
